notes: Defect: promo code/discount amount is incorrectly displayed for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations. The discount mapping in map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch passes the amount through as-is, but return trip tickets likely need the discount amount adjusted (the full order-level discount is probably being shown per-segment instead of correctly for the return segment). The return-trip-specific logic in create-reservations.mappers.ts and the discount application in apply-report-discounts.service.ts are the likely fix sites.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria with only diagnostic notes. I created the full AC set from scratch based on the defect description and technical notes. Key design decisions: (1) AC-1 and AC-2 together ensure both the per-segment correctness and the conservation property (sum of segments = total discount), which catches the likely bug where the full discount is shown per segment. (2) AC-3 is a regression guard for one-way trips. (3) AC-4 covers the no-discount edge case. (4) AC-5 covers the case where discounts are already per-segment, ensuring the fix doesn't double-adjust. (5) AC-6 targets the specific mapper file mentioned in technical notes. (6) AC-7 covers the zero-value edge case. (7) AC-8 ensures consistency between the apply-report-discounts service output and the final email display.

after.description: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. When a promo code is applied to an order that includes return trip tickets, the discount amount is missing or incorrect in the Mozio email confirmation for the return trip dispatch, while it displays correctly for outbound trips.
after.title: Fix promo code amount display for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations

notes: Addressing all 5 coordinator flags: (1) elaborating AC from the defect description since original ACs were empty, (2) this is openspec's primary AC authorship — no speckit compensation needed, (3) acceptanceChanged=true because we are adding ACs to an empty set, (4) openspec is performing full AC elaboration, (5) no split required — 3 ACs, single concern (promo code display in Mozio email for return trips), single runtime role. The defect is in the Mozio dispatch sanitization/mapping pipeline: the optional discount field on SanitizedMozioDispatch is either omitted or miscalculated when the dispatch corresponds to a return trip ticket. The create-reservations mapper swaps from/to stations for return trips but may not propagate the discount; the apply-report-discounts service may not apply discounts to return-trip dispatches; the sanitized-dispatch mapper may not include the discount for return dispatches.
